def load_model(path, device):
    ckpt = torch.load(path, weights_only=False, map_location=device)
    m = ProgressProbe(ckpt["embed_dim"], ckpt["hidden_size"],
                      ckpt["num_layers"], ckpt.get("dropout", 0.1)).to(device)
    m.load_state_dict(ckpt["model_state_dict"])
    m.eval()
    return m

@torch.no_grad()
def eval_model(model, embs_list, labs_list, device, bs=256):
    ds = WindowDataset(embs_list, labs_list)
    loader = DataLoader(ds, batch_size=bs, collate_fn=collate_fn)
    all_preds, all_labels = [], []
    for padded, labels, lengths in loader:
        logits = model(padded.to(device), lengths)
        preds = (torch.sigmoid(logits) >= 0.5).long().cpu().tolist()
        all_preds.extend(preds)
        all_labels.extend(labels.long().tolist())
    return all_labels, all_preds

def metrics_dict(labels, preds):
    cm = confusion_matrix(labels, preds, labels=[0,1])
    tn, fp, fn, tp = cm.ravel()
    return {
        "macro_f1": round(f1_score(labels, preds, average="macro", zero_division=0), 4),
        "accuracy": round(accuracy_score(labels, preds), 4),
        "f1_stag": round(f1_score(labels, preds, pos_label=0, zero_division=0), 4),
        "f1_prog": round(f1_score(labels, preds, pos_label=1, zero_division=0), 4),
        "precision_stag": round(precision_score(labels, preds, pos_label=0, zero_division=0), 4),
        "recall_stag": round(recall_score(labels, preds, pos_label=0, zero_division=0), 4),
        "precision_prog": round(precision_score(labels, preds, pos_label=1, zero_division=0), 4),
        "recall_prog": round(recall_score(labels, preds, pos_label=1, zero_division=0), 4),
        "TN": int(tn), "FP": int(fp), "FN": int(fn), "TP": int(tp),
        "n_stag": int(tn+fn), "n_prog": int(fp+tp), "n_total": int(tn+fp+fn+tp),
    }

def main():
    device = "cuda:0" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"
    print(f"Device: {device}\n")
    report = []

    # ======== Load 3-LF data ========
    print("Loading 3-LF data...")
    data = torch.load(DATA_DIR / "embeddings.pt", weights_only=False)
    embs = data["embeddings"]
    labs = data["labels"]
    iids = data["instance_ids"]
    confs = data.get("confidences", [1]*len(labs))
    N = len(embs)
    print(f"  Total: {N} windows\n")

    # ======== 1. probe_001 ========
    print("="*60)
    print("1. probe_001 (3-LF, conf>=2)")
    print("="*60)
    with open(BASE / "checkpoints/split_info.json") as f:
        si = json.load(f)
    keep_idx = si["keep_indices"]
    test_idx = si["test_indices"]
    # keep_indices maps to filtered array, test_indices index into filtered array
    filtered_embs = [embs[i] for i in keep_idx]
    filtered_labs = [labs[i] for i in keep_idx]
    test_embs = [filtered_embs[i] for i in test_idx]
    test_labs = [filtered_labs[i] for i in test_idx]
    
    model_p001 = load_model(BASE / "checkpoints/best_model.pt", device)
    p001_labels, p001_preds = eval_model(model_p001, test_embs, test_labs, device)
    p001_m = metrics_dict(p001_labels, p001_preds)
    
    print(f"  N={len(test_idx)}")
    print(classification_report(p001_labels, p001_preds, target_names=["stagnation","progress"], digits=4))
    print(f"  Metrics: {json.dumps(p001_m, indent=2)}")
    report.append(("probe_001 (conf>=2, N={})".format(p001_m['n_total']), p001_m))

    # Also get the 3-LF test indices in the original array for woob eval
    test_orig_indices = [keep_idx[i] for i in test_idx]
    
    # ======== 2. outcome-bp-3seed ========
    print("\n" + "="*60)
    print("2. outcome-bp-3seed (no-OB models on 3-LF full test)")
    print("="*60)
    
    with open(BASE / "checkpoints_full/split_info.json") as f:
        si_full = json.load(f)
    full_test_idx = si_full["test_indices"]
    full_test_embs = [embs[i] for i in full_test_idx]
    full_test_labs = [labs[i] for i in full_test_idx]
    
    seed_results = {}
    for seed in [42, 123, 456]:
        ckpt_dir = BASE / f"checkpoints_no_ob_seed{seed}"
        if not ckpt_dir.exists():
            print(f"  Seed {seed}: checkpoint dir not found, skip")
            continue
        model = load_model(ckpt_dir / "best_model.pt", device)
        s_labels, s_preds = eval_model(model, full_test_embs, full_test_labs, device)
        s_m = metrics_dict(s_labels, s_preds)
        seed_results[seed] = s_m
        print(f"\n  Seed {seed} (N={s_m['n_total']}):")
        print(classification_report(s_labels, s_preds, target_names=["stagnation","progress"], digits=4))
        report.append((f"outcome-bp-3seed s{seed} (N={s_m['n_total']})", s_m))
        del model
    
    if seed_results:
        mean_f1_stag = np.mean([v["f1_stag"] for v in seed_results.values()])
        std_f1_stag = np.std([v["f1_stag"] for v in seed_results.values()])
        mean_macro = np.mean([v["macro_f1"] for v in seed_results.values()])
        print(f"\n  Mean f1_stag = {mean_f1_stag:.4f} ± {std_f1_stag:.4f}")
        print(f"  Mean macro_f1 = {mean_macro:.4f}")

    # ======== 3. oh-full-finetune ========

    print("3. oh-full-finetune (OH test set)")
    print("="*60)
    
    oh_emb_path = Path("/root/autodl-tmp/openhands_data/embeddings.pt")
    if oh_emb_path.exists():
        oh_data = torch.load(oh_emb_path, weights_only=False)
        oh_embs = oh_data["embeddings"]
        oh_labs = oh_data["labels"]
        oh_iids = oh_data["instance_ids"]
        _, _, oh_test_idx = split_by_instance(oh_iids, seed=42)
        
        oh_test_embs = [oh_embs[i] for i in oh_test_idx]
        oh_test_labs = [oh_labs[i] for i in oh_test_idx]
        
        model_oh = load_model(BASE / "checkpoints_oh_full/best_model.pt", device)
        oh_labels, oh_preds = eval_model(model_oh, oh_test_embs, oh_test_labs, device)
        oh_m = metrics_dict(oh_labels, oh_preds)
        
        print(f"  N={len(oh_test_idx)}")
        print(classification_report(oh_labels, oh_preds, target_names=["stagnation","progress"], digits=4))
        print(f"  Metrics: {json.dumps(oh_m, indent=2)}")
        report.append(("oh-full-finetune OH-test (N={})".format(oh_m['n_total']), oh_m))
        del model_oh, oh_data, oh_embs
    else:
        print(f"  OH embeddings not found at {oh_emb_path}")
        oh_m = None

    # ======== 4. woob on conf>=2 3-LF test set (N=1824) ========
    print("\n" + "="*60)
    print("4. woob model on 3-LF conf>=2 test set")
    print("="*60)
    
    model_woob = load_model(BASE / "checkpoints_without_ob/best_model.pt", device)
    # Use same test set as probe_001 (conf>=2 filtered)
    woob_labels, woob_preds = eval_model(model_woob, test_embs, test_labs, device)

    print(f"  N={woob_m['n_total']} (conf>=2 3-LF test set)")
    print(classification_report(woob_labels, woob_preds, target_names=["stagnation","progress"], digits=4))
    print(f"  Metrics: {json.dumps(woob_m, indent=2)}")
    report.append(("woob on conf>=2 3-LF test (N={})".format(woob_m['n_total']), woob_m))
    
    # Also eval woob on full 3-LF test set for comparison
    woob_full_labels, woob_full_preds = eval_model(model_woob, full_test_embs, full_test_labs, device)
    woob_full_m = metrics_dict(woob_full_labels, woob_full_preds)
    print(f"\n  woob on full 3-LF test (N={woob_full_m['n_total']}) for comparison:")
    print(f"  {json.dumps(woob_full_m, indent=2)}")
    report.append(("woob on full 3-LF test (N={})".format(woob_full_m['n_total']), woob_full_m))
    del model_woob

    # ======== 5. Full model baseline on conf>=2 test ========
    print("\n" + "="*60)
    print("5. Full model (checkpoints_full) on conf>=2 test set (reference)")
    print("="*60)
    model_full = load_model(BASE / "checkpoints_full/best_model.pt", device)
    full_labels, full_preds = eval_model(model_full, test_embs, test_labs, device)
    full_m = metrics_dict(full_labels, full_preds)
    print(f"  N={full_m['n_total']}")
    print(classification_report(full_labels, full_preds, target_names=["stagnation","progress"], digits=4))
    report.append(("full-model on conf>=2 (N={})".format(full_m['n_total']), full_m))
    del model_full

    # ======== Summary Table ========
    print("\n" + "="*80)
    print("SUMMARY TABLE")
    print("="*80)
    header = f"{'Experiment':<45} {'macro_f1':>8} {'f1_stag':>8} {'f1_prog':>8} {'P_stag':>7} {'R_stag':>7} {'N':>6}"

    # ======== Save results ========
    results = {name: m for name, m in report}
    with open(BASE / "f1_breakdown_results.json", "w") as f:
        json.dump(results, f, indent=2)
    print(f"\nSaved to {BASE / 'f1_breakdown_results.json'}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
